WebGPU 4DGS Showcase vs. On-Device Real-Time 3D Fitting Room

Faltwerk 4DGS excels at zero-install, ultra-compact playback of a choreographed 3D outfit showcase on the web. Inside the native DressWell iOS and Android app, garments remain interactive skeletal PBR meshes rendered on-device with Filament — letting you sculpt proportions, swap fabrics from photos, and freely mix and layer tops, dresses, and coats offline with zero server uploads.
